get.summary: List flights with related records expanded
get.description: A scheduled flight leg, with its aircraft (fleet service) and its crew assignments and crew members (personnel service) joined server-side in one request.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated related records to embed in each flight: `aircraft` (the flight's airframe), `assignments` (its crew assignments), `assignments.crew` (each assignment's crew member; implies `assignments`).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated dotted paths to return, relative to the flight; the flight id is always returned, and a path into a list applies to every item. Omit to return full records. Flight fields are those of listFlight; `aircraft.*` those of listAircraft; `assignments.*` those of listAssignment; `assignments.crew.*` those of listCrewMember. Nested values can be selected the same way, e.g. `aircraft.model.code`, `assignments.crew.typeRatings.expiresAt`.

parameters.name: assignmentRoles
parameters.description: Comma-separated assignment roles to embed, e.g. CAPTAIN,FIRST_OFFICER for flight-deck crew only. Omit for the full roster.
